context: This image is an isolated SDF Modeler kit-asset view: one candy-world obstacle rendered alone on a plain neutral studio backdrop, as the project's view spec requires, not a gameplay screenshot. The course, characters, environment, sky and bloom of the reference are absent by design. Grade the piece only, against the matching piece of the reference: glossy inflatable pink/yellow/blue look, white zigzags or candy stripes, chunky rounded rims and toy-like proportions.

views.description: candy.pendulum-hammer, the inflatable hammer of ref-1: a fat glossy pink drum-shaped head lying along X with chunky rounded yellow rims and blue end faces, a white zigzag band printed around its middle, on a blue inflatable arm with yellow collars rising to a yellow pivot hub on a pink axle, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.spinner-bar, the rotating spinner bar of ref-1: a long fat glossy pink inflatable tube with white helical candy stripes, chunky rounded yellow end caps and yellow collars, on a rounded pink hub cap over a yellow post and a blue base with a yellow rim, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/white inflatable style. Camera: the project's front three-quarter view (camera on +X+Z at yaw 45 degrees); the view spec raises the eye by only a quarter of the piece's height, so this long, low bar is seen almost at eye level: its near (+X) end is larger in perspective, and the base shows as a band under the hub rather than from above

candy.floor-tile, a square floor tile of ref-1's floating platforms: a thick glossy candy slab with a flat light-blue walkable top pad, a chunky rounded yellow inflatable rim around the top edge, a pink side band printed with a bold white zigzag all around, and a rounded yellow bottom rim, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The slab is low and wide, so from this raised view the overhanging yellow/pink top rim hides most of the side band: the side band, its white zigzag and the bottom rim show as a narrow strip under the rim, with the zigzag standing proud of the band

candy.floor-disc, a round floor disc of ref-1's floating platforms: a thick glossy candy disc with a flat pink walkable top carrying a white ring and centre dot target, a chunky rounded yellow inflatable rim around the top edge, a blue side band printed with a bold white zigzag all around, and a rounded yellow bottom rim, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The slab is low and wide, so from this raised view the overhanging yellow/pink top rim hides most of the side band: the side band, its white zigzag and the bottom rim show as a narrow strip under the rim, with the zigzag standing proud of the band

candy.moving-platform, a small square floating platform of ref-1: a thick glossy candy slab with a flat yellow walkable top pad, a chunky rounded pink inflatable rim around the top edge, a blue side band printed with a bold white zigzag all around, and a rounded pink bottom rim, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The slab is low and wide, so from this raised view the overhanging yellow/pink top rim hides most of the side band: the side band, its white zigzag and the bottom rim show as a narrow strip under the rim, with the zigzag standing proud of the band

candy.bounce-pad, the bounce pad of ref-1: a squat glossy inflatable drum with a chunky rounded blue rim printed with a bold white zigzag band all around, topped by a springy glossy pink dome with a yellow ring and a yellow centre disc carrying a white six-point star mark, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.conveyor-belt, a candy conveyor belt in ref-1's style: a long, low glossy pink inflatable slab with rounded edges, a yellow lip and pink belt top with white chevron stripes pointing along +Z (toward the left end, which has a rounded blue roller cap), white chevrons repeated along its pink side, in ref-1's glossy inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.finish-arch, the crown arch at the finish of ref-1: a big glossy inflatable arch with two chunky round posts (one pink with a blue band, one blue with a pink band) ringed by rounded yellow rims and standing on yellow bases, a chunky rounded yellow beam across the top with a pink band printed with a bold white zigzag, and a yellow crown on top whose points carry pink and blue jewel balls, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.checkpoint-gate, a smaller checkpoint arch of the same candy family as ref-1's crown arch: two chunky round inflatable posts (one pink with a blue band, one blue with a pink band) ringed by rounded yellow rims on yellow bases, a rounded yellow beam across the top with a pink band printed with a bold white zigzag, and a small pink pennant flag on a short white pole at the centre of the beam, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.rotating-door, a rotating door obstacle like ref-1's inflatable obstacles: two crossed glossy inflatable panels, one pink and one blue, each framed by chunky rounded yellow inflatable edges and printed with a bold white zigzag, turning on a central yellow hub with pink and blue rings and a pink ball on top, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The two panels cross at the central hub at right angles (the hub is at their meeting point); from the 45 degree view the two panels project as two wings of an X-like arrangement around the hub, so they can look nearly side by side, and the white zigzags read slightly pale on the shaded panel; judge the parts, colours and glossy inflatable finish

candy.seesaw-plank, a see-saw plank like ref-1's inflatable platforms: a long rounded glossy yellow plank framed by puffy pink inflatable rims on all four sides, with a bold white zigzag running along its top and a blue round fulcrum with yellow end caps under its middle, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). The plank is low, long and shown at a shallow angle: its blue fulcrum (a cylinder across the plank width with yellow end caps) sits under the middle of the plank, so in this view only the near end cap and a sliver of blue show below the rim, and the far end is hidden behind the plank; this is correct. The finish is the same smooth glossy inflatable shading as the rest of the kit, with a bright highlight along the pink rims

candy.wall-block, a padded wall like ref-1's inflatable walls: a long puffy wall made of five rounded inflatable cushions alternating blue and pink, sitting on a rounded yellow base under a rounded yellow top rail, with a white zigzag trim running along both faces, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly). Only the near (+Z) face and the +X end are visible in this view, so the zigzag trim is judged on the visible face only; the zigzag is white, slightly shaded in the lower light

candy.queue-pad, a round hub queue pad like ref-1's round candy pads: a low glossy pink cushion top sitting in a chunky rounded yellow inflatable rim with a white zigzag edge around its side, four white L-shaped corner brackets on the pink top framing a white ring with a blue centre dot (a queue-pad target marking, not arrows), in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.plaza-fountain, a plaza fountain in ref-1's inflatable candy look: a round pink basin on a yellow foot with a chunky rounded yellow rim and a white zigzag band around its side, filled with a glossy bright green slime surface, and a central tiered pink column with a yellow dish holding blue water, a smaller pink dish with blue water, and a yellow ball with a small blue water drop on top, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)

candy.podium-block, a podium block like ref-1's padded inflatable blocks: a square padded pink block with chunky rounded yellow rims at its top and bottom edges, a puffy blue cushion on top, and a bold white zigzag trim running around all four sides, in ref-1's glossy pink/yellow/blue inflatable candy style, seen from a front three-quarter angle (camera on +X+Z, looking down slightly)
